subject: QA: zonoid — workspace resolution broken across e2e/daemon-boot suites
description:
NIGHTLY QA (2026-06-18) — NEW reproducible regression (last night 2026-06-17 was clean, failures=[]). Reproduced on one rerun each.

REPRO (cwd /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid):
  ./scripts/qa-suite.sh test/bench-e2e.test.js
  ./scripts/qa-suite.sh test/bench-snapshot-daemon.test.js
  ./scripts/qa-suite.sh test/cursor-e2e-integration.test.js
  ./scripts/qa-suite.sh test/retrieval-warmup-gate.test.js

SYMPTOMS (shared root cause — workspace resolution):
- bench-e2e (exit=1): scripts/bench-e2e.js:119 seedGraphOnArm → Error: edge seed failed: {"ok":false,"error":"no workspace resolved — pass workspace (body or ?workspace=)"}. The bench seed endpoint no longer resolves a default/implicit workspace.
- bench-snapshot-daemon (exit=1, 12 passed/1 failed): FAIL "booted: daemon workspace is the frozen snapshot" — booted snapshot daemon's resolved workspace != SNAPSHOT_WS.
- cursor-e2e-integration (exit=1, 33 passed/1 failed): FAIL "sessionStart: workspace registered" — sessionStart no longer registers the workspace.
- retrieval-warmup-gate (exit=1, 2 passed/1 failed/1 skipped): FAIL "live: /search converges to all-semantic (embedder warm)" — LIKELY DOWNSTREAM: this live test boots the SAME snapshot daemon; if it comes up with the wrong/unresolved workspace its /search has no embeddings → never converges to semantic. Timing-sensitive; treat as a symptom of the snapshot-daemon issue, not independent.

SUSPECT DELTA TASKS (landed/merged in window 2026-06-17→06-18): the workspace-overlay refactor feature d7674989-1220-4c98-b891-80ca9e2e803b — "P3: Remove state.workspace / state.overlay / WS_FILE / boot pin" (/4), "P2b: Sweeps/loops/routes/dashboard enumerate workspaces explicitly" (/3), "P2a: Per-workspace overlay cache" (/2), "P1: warn on global-workspace fallback" (/1); impl tasks canceled, JUDGE tasks /5-/8 done. This refactor removed the global workspace pin — exactly the implicit resolution these e2e/boot paths relied on.

FIX DIRECTION (for morning, do NOT fix at night): make bench-e2e.js seed calls pass an explicit ?workspace=/body.workspace; ensure the snapshot daemon boot and cursor sessionStart register/resolve their workspace explicitly post-refactor. Related prior context: task 688a3742.../6 "daemon workspace gremlin" and 230ef36e.../2 "active-claim searches all workspaces".
